newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: MALAYSIA STOCKS - factors to watch - March 26.
newsitem.headline: MALAYSIA STOCKS - factors to watch - March 26.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Malaysian stocks on Wednesday:
* On Tuesday in the U.S., the Dow Jones Industrial Average lost 29.08 points to close at 6,876.17 after an expected 25 basis point increase in short-term interest rates.
* The Kuala Lumpur Composite Index gained 2.74 points to close at 1,217.34 on a technical rebound.
* Malaysian Resources Corp Bhd announced a group consolidation which will see its stake in the New Straits Times going to its other associate Sistem Televisyen Malaysia Bhd.
* At 0025 GMT, the Japanese Nikkei 225 index was trading 68.58 points lower to 18254.53.
* Analysts and dealers said the 25 basis point Fed funds rate increase had been broadly discounted by the Kuala Lumpur market, and so would not have a significant impact.

* Malaysia's central bank releases its annual report on Friday. "Our concern is more to do with Bank Negara's reserves and operating profits rather than the economic data, which should not be too different from the treasury report (published in October)," said Ooi Soon Beng, head of research at Inter-Pacific Securities.
